_comment: v5.2.75 (UP-06) prayer calculation methods: angles mirror domain/prayer.js METHODS, regions/notes mirror the prayer.methodRegion.* / prayer.methodNote.* i18n keys (which is what views render). A contracts test pins JSON <-> domain <-> i18n equality so the three can never drift. v5.17.40 adds optional per-method `source` provenance ({body, document, url?, verified}): body names the convention institution, document names the convention, verified stays false until an official publication is confirmed — SOURCES.md prayer section cites only secondary corroboration, so nothing here claims official status.
